Req for: CTAs
Use: Use: primary button fills; optional for avatars, badges and other elements that carry text. Not a standalone color: it has no contrast guarantee of its own, only its on-text has one. Use it alone or with its hover and pressed states. Always bordered with its edge
Theming: fully re-solved per theme and family (gray)

Req for: CTA pointer-over state
Use: Use: the pointer-over state of the fill, with the fill; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows its rest fill (gray)

Req for: CTA pressed state
Use: Use: the pressed state of the fill, with the fill; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows its rest fill (gray)

Req for: min APCA visibility
Use: Use: the border of the fill and its states, always rendered with them and never without them (it resolves to transparent unless the fill sits close to the page); for nothing else
Theming: draws for CTAs that sit close to the page; strength per family tier (gray)

Req for: text over the CTA color
Use: AA standard body text over its CTA
Use: the only text color over the fill; never elsewhere
Theming: whichever pole passes; quiet CTAs take the soft pole (gray)
